metric: Median sale price, all property types
note: Each price is the TRREB median sale price for all property types in the matching TRREB community for January to March 2026, as a plain number with no symbols. Milliken Mills is null because TRREB reports it as two communities (East and West). Downtown Markham is null because TRREB does not report it as a community. Neighbourhoods with a null price are skipped on the ticker. Unionville's median is pulled down by condo apartment sales.
